tool.help:
# B2BTools: Single Sequence Analysis
## Description The current Galaxy Tool is the implementation of the Bio2Byte tools for single protein sequence analysis. It receives amino-acid sequences in FASTA format and returns biophysical predictions based on the selected predictors.
## Inputs - **Input FASTA File**: Valid FASTA file containing at least one sequence of amino acids. - **Select Predictors**: Choose the biophysical predictors to run. - **Plot predicted features by sequence**: Check to plot predicted features for each sequence in separate files. - **Plot all predicted features together**: Check to plot all predicted features for all sequences in a single file.
## Outputs - **Predicted Features JSON**: Contains predicted features for each sequence in JSON format. - **Predicted Features TSV**: Contains predicted features for each sequence in tabular format.
## Example Checking **Plot** parameter implies that predicted features will be plotted in different files by input sequence. 11 input sequences x 9 predicted features = 99 plots in PNG format. Checking **Plot all** parameter implies that all the input sequences will be plotted together in order to compare predicted features. 9 predicted features = 9 plots in PNG format.
